SC-2025-S1241.title: Chief Deputy Clifton J. Howle
SC-2025-S1241.summary: A SENATE RESOLUTION TO EXPRESS PROFOUND SORROW UPON THE PASSING OF CHIEF DEPUTY CLIFTON J. HOWLE AND TO EXTEND THE DEEPEST SYMPATHY TO HIS FAMILY AND MANY FRIENDS.
SC-2025-S1241.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-S1241.aiSummary: The Senate would express sorrow at the death of Chief Deputy Clifton J. Howle and extend sympathy to his family and friends. It was introduced and adopted.

SC-2025-S1234.title: Sally Karr Leonard
SC-2025-S1234.summary: A SENATE RESOLUTION TO CONGRATULATE SALLY KARR LEONARD ON THE OCCASION OF HER SEVENTIETH BIRTHDAY AND TO WISH HER A JOYOUS BIRTHDAY CELEBRATION AND MUCH HAPPINESS IN THE DAYS AHEAD.
SC-2025-S1234.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-S1234.aiSummary: A Senate resolution congratulates Sally Karr Leonard on her 70th birthday. It also wishes her a joyful birthday celebration and happiness in the days ahead. The resolution was introduced and adopted on August 25, 2026.

SC-2025-H5807.title: Alica James obituary and memorial service
SC-2025-H5807.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO EXPRESS PROFOUND SORROW UPON THE PASSING OF ALICA VAN RENSALIER LEWIS JAMES OF ORANGEBURG AND TO EXTEND DEEPEST SYMPATHY TO HER LOVING FAMILY AND MANY FRIENDS.
SC-2025-H5807.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5807.aiSummary: A House resolution expresses sorrow over the death of Alica Van Rensalier Lewis James of Orangeburg and extends sympathy to her family and friends. It was introduced and adopted by the House.

SC-2025-H5800.title: Friendship United Methodist Church 160th Anniversary
SC-2025-H5800.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO CELEBRATE THE JOYOUS OCCASION OF THE ONE HUNDRED SIXTIETH ANNIVERSARY OF FRIENDSHIP UNITED METHODIST CHURCH AND TO CONGRATULATE AND COMMEND THE REVEREND DR. ERNEST W. FRIERSON AND THE CONGREGATION FOR THEIR YEARS OF DEDICATED SERVICE TO THE NESMITH COMMUNITY.
SC-2025-H5800.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5800.aiSummary: This resolution celebrates the 160th anniversary of Friendship United Methodist Church. It also congratulates and commends Reverend Dr. Ernest W. Frierson and the congregation for their years of service to the Nesmith community. It was introduced and adopted.

SC-2025-S769.title: Continuing Resolution
SC-2025-S769.summary: A JOINT RESOLUTION TO PROVIDE FOR THE CONTINUING AUTHORITY TO PAY THE EXPENSES OF STATE GOVERNMENT IF THE 2026-2027 FISCAL YEAR BEGINS WITHOUT A GENERAL APPROPRIATIONS ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026-2027 HAVING BEEN ENACTED, AND TO PROVIDE EXCEPTIONS. - RATIFIED TITLE
SC-2025-S769.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)

actions.text: Committee report: Favorable Ways and Means
Referred to Committee on Ways and Means
Read third time and sent to House

SC-2025-S769.aiSummary: This joint resolution would keep state government funded if the 2026-2027 budget is not in place when that fiscal year starts. It would also set out some exceptions. It became law on May 15, 2026.

SC-2025-S1227.title: Ned Shows
SC-2025-S1227.summary: A SENATE RESOLUTION TO CONGRATULATE AND HONOR NED SHOWS FOR FORTY YEARS OF VOLUNTEER WORK WITH MEALS ON WHEELS SUMMERVILLE, AND FOR HIS MANY YEARS OF DEDICATED SERVICE WITHIN THE SUMMERVILLE COMMUNITY.
SC-2025-S1227.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-S1227.aiSummary: A Senate resolution would honor Ned Shows for 40 years of volunteer work with Meals on Wheels Summerville and for many years of service in the Summerville community. It was introduced and adopted.

SC-2025-S1220.title: Mt. Seal United Methodist Church Anniversary
SC-2025-S1220.summary: A SENATE RESOLUTION TO CONGRATULATE MT. SEAL UNITED METHODIST CHURCH UPON THE OCCASION OF ITS ONE HUNDRED SEVENTIETH ANNIVERSARY AND TO COMMEND THE CHURCH FOR ITS MANY YEARS OF DEDICATED SERVICE TO THE WILLIAMSBURG COMMUNITY AND THE PEOPLE AND THE STATE OF SOUTH CAROLINA.
SC-2025-S1220.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-S1220.aiSummary: The Senate adopted a resolution to congratulate Mt. Seal United Methodist Church on its 170th anniversary. It also commends the church for its long service to the Williamsburg community and to South Carolina.

SC-2025-H5786.title: H.E. Mai Mala Buni
SC-2025-H5786.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO HONOR THE LIFE AND ACHIEVEMENTS OF PROMINENT AFRICAN POLITICAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE LEADER HIS EXCELLENCY MAI MALA BUNI, EXECUTIVE GOVERNOR OF YOBE STATE, NIGERIA.
SC-2025-H5786.summarySource: South Carolina legislature, description (via Open States)
SC-2025-H5786.aiSummary: A House resolution honors the life and achievements of His Excellency Mai Mala Buni, the executive governor of Yobe State, Nigeria. It is a formal statement by lawmakers about an African political and administrative leader. The resolution was introduced and adopted on August 11, 2026.

SC-2025-H5751.title: Vanester Evans
SC-2025-H5751.summary: A HOUSE RESOLUTION TO RECOGNIZE AND HONOR VANESTER EVANS FOR HER FAITHFUL AND DEVOTED SERVICE TO SAINT PAUL AFRICAN METHODIST EPISCOPAL CHURCH IN HORRY COUNTY.

SC-2025-H5751.aiSummary: A House resolution would recognize and honor Vanester Evans for her faithful and devoted service to Saint Paul African Methodist Episcopal Church in Horry County. It was introduced and adopted.
